analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($202.00) vs SMA5 ($199.26) / SMA20 ($192.57) / SMA50 ($187.19): confirmed above short- and mid-term trends.
· High position relative to SMA100 ($185.07) / SMA200 ($165.19): indicates strong mid- to long-term trend.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (66.3→71.7): confirmed overbought entry, sustained upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.6582→0.7934): confirmed improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $204.18): approaching upper band, with band width expanding at 12.06%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($182.08): based on 20-day low, distant from current price.
· Swing resistance (N/A): Pivot R1 ($209.47) acts as a short-term resistance level.
· 5-day / 20-day high/low pattern: entering a Higher Low recovery phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.73x): contracted compared to the 5-day average, slightly reducing confidence in the move.
· Current phase diagnosis: Uptrend phase, Higher Low recovery initiation confirmed. Bullish bias persists with RSI overbought and MACD improving. Volume contraction suggests potential for short-term consolidation, but the trend remains intact.
